items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

ctx.x: Okay here’s what I’m dealing with.

But he does about a half hour just with the audience alone. And then he says, “I feel like playing the piano” and he moves over, and I’ve been playing all this funny stuff behind him. Because a lot of the names, if we get a four syllable name, like Harry Sosneck, you know I’ll go [scats] and he’ll sing “Barney Google” then “Harry Sosneck” with goo-goo- googly eyes, and just little things I throw at him for laughs, and play funny music behind him. And then he’ll sit down at the piano and I move over to the other…
It seems like you’ve had some very fortunate working situations throughout your career that really gave you what you needed for the rest of your career.
